preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^9.
The number of extra edges is between 0 and 4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in extra_edges)
preconditions.description: Each extra edge connects two distinct nodes within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output is the total number of simple paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
